summary: Verified the CSRF/419 fix for message send on first SPA visit. All 4 target flows pass: (1) buyer navigates via SPA (dashboard → sidebar 'Mesajlar' link → conversation 2 SPA click) without any full reload, and sends 2 messages on FIRST try — both POST /messages/2 returned 200, no 419, and bubbles A and B appeared immediately. (2) After a full page reload of /messages/2, a subsequent send also returned POST 200. (3) Admin support reply on /admin/support/1 with data-testid=reply-body + reply-btn returned POST /admin/support/1/reply 200, no 419. (4) Story delete flow: buyer opens story-user-3, story-delete is visible; SweetAlert appears and clicking 'Vazgeç' cancels without any CSRF error and without issuing any DELETE (data preserved as requested).
critical_code_review_comments: CSRF sharing via Inertia props (page.props.csrf_token) + AppLayout syncCsrfMeta on router success is a solid, low-risk pattern; verified end-to-end.
csrfHeaders() preference order (explicit token > XSRF cookie > meta) works both for SPA-first send and post-refresh send.
test_credentials: buyer@test.com / password, seller@test.com / password, admin@test.com / password (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: None. TEST 4 clicked 'Vazgeç' to preserve story data as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form has no type=email; first two visible inputs of form.auth-form are email/username (id=email) and password. Use context.clear_cookies() before re-login as another user because /login redirects when authenticated. Sidebar SPA link 'Mesajlar' (data-testid=sidebar-messages) reaches /messages; conversation clicks land on /messages/{id}. Message send observations captured via response listener: POST /messages/2 returned 200 on first-try SPA send and after full refresh. Admin reply POST /admin/support/1/reply returned 200. window.Inertia is not exposed; use direct navigation or click anchor for SPA.
rca of the issue: Previously the SPA had a stale <meta name=csrf-token> after login/nav which caused POST /messages/{id} to receive 419. Fix (HandleInertiaRequests shares fresh csrf_token; AppLayout syncs meta+axios default header on router success; send() explicitly passes page.props.csrf_token as X-CSRF-TOKEN) confirmed to prevent the 419 on first SPA visit. No 419 observed in any tested flow.
